value.short: Create a harness and publish revision 1
value.long:
Create a harness from the shortcut flags or a complete --request body. Managed harnesses run in VPC mode only: --role-arn, --subnet-id and --security-group-id are required and cannot be changed after create. The service saves the draft, creates revision 1, and starts publishing it asynchronously: it creates a Sandbox Tool and then a Deployment.

Without --wait the command returns after the request is accepted. With --wait it polls revision 1 until PUBLISHED or PUBLISH_FAILED. Timing out or pressing Ctrl+C stops only the local wait.

Create is not idempotent and the CLI never retries it. If the result is unknown after a timeout, check with 'agr harness list --name <name>' before running create again. Available in preview builds.
examples:
Example - Minimal harness with one model:
  agr harness create --name my-agent --engine pi --engine-version 1.3.0 \
    --model mp-a1b2c3d4:hy3 \
    --role-arn qcs::cam::uin/100000000001:roleName/AgentRole \
    --subnet-id subnet-a1b2c3d4 --security-group-id sg-a1b2c3d4 --wait -o text

Example - Two providers with an explicit default model, a Skill and a prompt file:
  agr harness create --name support-bot --engine pi --engine-version 1.3.0 \
    --model mp-a1b2c3d4:hy3 --model mp-e5f6g7h8:deepseek-v3 --default-model mp-e5f6g7h8:deepseek-v3 \
    --skill reg-0123abcd/rec-0123abcd/rv-0123abcd --system-prompt @prompt.md \
    --role-arn qcs::cam::uin/100000000001:roleName/AgentRole \
    --subnet-id subnet-a1b2c3d4 --security-group-id sg-a1b2c3d4 \
    --initialize-configuration @init.json --tags team=support

Example - Preview the final request without creating anything:
  agr harness create --name my-agent --engine pi --engine-version 1.3.0 \
    --model mp-a1b2c3d4:hy3 --role-arn qcs::cam::uin/100000000001:roleName/AgentRole \
    --subnet-id subnet-a1b2c3d4 --security-group-id sg-a1b2c3d4 --dry-run -o json

Example - Create from a complete request body:
  agr harness create --generate-skeleton > harness.json
  agr harness create --request @harness.json --wait

value.short: Delete a harness and its Deployment
value.long:
Delete a harness. The service deletes the managed Deployment and then removes the harness, its revisions, and references. The Sandbox Tool, model providers, session spaces, Registry assets, and credentials are kept; remove the Sandbox Tool with 'agr tool delete' if it is no longer needed.

Interactive terminals ask for confirmation. Non-interactive callers must pass --yes. A DELETE_FAILED harness can be deleted again. Available in preview builds.
examples:
Example - Preview the deletion:
  agr harness delete hns-a1b2c3d4 --dry-run

Example - Delete and wait until the harness is gone:
  agr harness delete hns-a1b2c3d4 --yes --wait

value.short: Freeze the harness draft as a new revision
value.long: Create an immutable revision from the current harness draft. The revision pins the latest revision of each referenced model provider and starts as UNPUBLISHED. Use --publish to publish it in the same command; the two requests are not a transaction, so a publish failure still returns the new revision number. Available in preview builds.
examples:
Example - Freeze and publish the draft:
  agr harness revision create hns-a1b2c3d4 --publish --wait -o text

Example - Freeze with a name and publish later:
  agr harness revision create hns-a1b2c3d4 --name release-candidate -o text
  agr harness revision publish hns-a1b2c3d4 3 --wait

name.usage: Revision name. DNS-1123 subdomain: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '.', at most 253 characters. Names may repeat; use the returned ID to address resources. Defaults to v<revision>.

value.long: Show the frozen configuration and publish status of one revision. StatusReason explains PUBLISH_FAILED. Available in preview builds.

  agr harness revision get hns-a1b2c3d4 2 -o text

Example - Read only the status:
  agr harness revision get hns-a1b2c3d4 2 -o json --jq '.Data.HarnessRevision.Status'

value.long: List retained revisions of a harness, newest first. The service keeps the latest 10 revisions plus PUBLISHED and PUBLISHING ones. Available in preview builds.
examples:
Example - Show revision history:
  agr harness revision list hns-a1b2c3d4 -o text

Example - Find the live revision number:
  agr harness revision list hns-a1b2c3d4 -o json --jq '.Data.HarnessRevisionSet[] | select(.Status=="PUBLISHED") | .Revision'

value.long:
Publish a revision asynchronously. UNPUBLISHED, PUBLISH_FAILED and SUPERSEDED revisions can be published; republishing an earlier revision is how you roll back. If the revision is already PUBLISHED, the command reports AlreadyPublished and sends no request, so retries are safe.

Publishing changes only instances created afterwards; existing instances and sessions keep their configuration. Available in preview builds.
examples:
Example - Publish and wait for the outcome:
  agr harness revision publish hns-a1b2c3d4 3 --wait -o text

Example - Roll back to revision 1:
  agr harness revision publish hns-a1b2c3d4 1 --wait
